release_notes: Changed default automation speed to 50% slower
changes: Default automation speed changed from 20% slower to 50% slower
All automation delays are now 50% longer by default
Speed selector still shows '1x' as default
1.5x speed is now equivalent to original unmodified speed
Provides more stable and reliable automation by default
